subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery surface, and which recovery actions should be default, opt-in, or out of scope?
rationale: The request crosses process supervision, config/schema, doctor repair, notifications, degraded startup, health protocol, and security-sensitive operator authority, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Design Opt-In Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a narrow opt-in recovery policy and split implementation into smaller owned follow-ups.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close or supersede this broad item only after creating explicit canonical issues for process watchdog, health schema, error policy, degraded startup, and notifications.

options.title: Reject Core Ownership
options.body: Decide that recovery remains external/operator-managed for now and document supervisor, plugin, or ClawHub patterns instead of adding core behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Design Opt-In Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a narrow opt-in recovery policy and split implementation into smaller owned follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal across Gateway lifecycle, crash-loop breaker, unhandled errors, and recovery-adjacent paths.
